mechanics.name: Fruits of Your Labor
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever a Generator is completed, you gain 1 Token. Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token you gain 5% Haste for 2 seconds and 10/15/20% Healing progress, according to perk tier.
activation: Whenever any Generator is completed, gain 1 Token.
You must finish repairing a Generator to trigger the per-Token Haste and Healing progress.
Ends/deactivates when: Each Haste instance lasts 2 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Generator completions build tokens that grant a brief Haste boost and Healing progress when you finish repairing a Generator.
duration: Haste: 2 seconds per Token when you finish repairing a Generator.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Gain 1 Token whenever any Generator is completed. No cap, token expenditure, loss, or expiry is stated in the current effect text; tokens remain available for each time you finish repairing a Generator.
specialInteractions: The per-Token Haste and Healing progress occur when you finish repairing a Generator, not merely when another Generator is completed.

editorial.summary: Generator completions build Tokens; when you finish repairing a generator, each Token grants a brief Haste bonus and permanent healing progress toward your current Health State.
useCases: Convert late generator completions into a large chunk of healing progress.
Finish a generator while injured and immediately gain movement plus self-recovery progress.
Benefit more in later game when several completion Tokens have accumulated.
counters: You must personally finish a generator to cash the Tokens.
Early-game activations have few Tokens and modest payoff.
If you are already Healthy, the healing portion can be wasted.
pros: Rewards the main objective rather than a side quest.
Scaling improves naturally as the Trial progresses.
Can combine objective completion, healing progress, and movement in one trigger.
cons: Needs the perk owner to be on the exact generator when it completes.
Part of the trigger is wasted in some health states.
analysis: Fruits of Your Labor ranks high in C because the perk scales with match progression rather than requiring an unrelated chore. Every generator completion creates future value, and the payout happens when you personally finish a generator later.

The healing progress is the more interesting reward. If several Tokens are banked and you finish a late generator while injured, the perk can remove a large portion of the next heal without requiring anyone to stop repairing beforehand.

The brief Haste can help with the immediate post-completion rotation, but it is not a replacement for a true Exhaustion perk. The important question is whether you can reliably be present for the generator finish that cashes the stack.

That ownership problem keeps the perk in C. Solo Q teammates may finish objectives without you, and an early finish pays very little. In a coordinated objective build, the scaling can be planned much more deliberately.
editorial.verdict: A promising late-objective payoff that asks you to own the generator finish. Fruits of Your Labor can compress a later heal nicely, but its value arrives on the match's schedule.
